claims.source_quote_ar: لو صح وأمكن ولم يؤدّ إلى مفسدة لوجب
claims.claim_ar: النسق الإنشائي بوسم التخيُّل بـ«لو/ولَوْ» لاستئناف صورة متطرّفة افتراضية بغرض الحسم والتقييد: أي أنّ الحكم - النفي/التحريم هنا - لا يُنقَض حتى في أقصى حالة افتراضية كأن يكون المشركون أولي قربى.
claims.claim_en: Use of the concessive/hypothetical 'wa-law' to introduce an extreme hypothetical case so as to close off exceptions and thereby strengthen the ruling: the negation/prohibition stands even in the extreme concession that they were close relatives.
claims.needs_review_reason: The source chunk discusses a similar use of 'لو' in a different exegetical context (discussion of permissibility/obligation); mapping that general principle to this verse is plausible but not explicitly argued in the provided chunks for S9:113.

claims.claim_ar: الصياغة النفيّة «مَا كَانَ ... أَنْ يَسْتَغْفِرُوا» تُفهم كتوكيد للنفي وقطعٍ للإمكانية (نفي تأكيدي)، أي أنه ليس من شأن النبيّ والمؤمنين أن يطلبوا الاستغفار للمشركين؛ النفي هنا مؤكدٌ لا مجرد خبرٍ ماضٍ.
claims.claim_en: The negative construction 'ma kana ... an yastaghfiru' functions as an emphatic negation that rules out the possibility: it is not (and should not be regarded as) the Prophet's or believers' role to seek forgiveness for the polytheists — the negation is emphatic rather than a neutral past statement.
claims.needs_review_reason: The quoted source phrase refers to 'اللام لتأكيد النفي' (a discussion of emphatic lam in a different commentary excerpt). Applying that exact explanatory point to the present verse (which uses 'ما كان') requires careful checking of whether the commentator intended the same mechanism here; the mapping is therefore tentative.

warnings: The provided source chunks are commentary excerpts on several verses and constructions; some quoted substrings are taken from discussions of analogous grammatical/rhetorical phenomena in other contexts rather than an explicit commentary on S9:113. Claims therefore are inferential and should be reviewed against full classical discussions of S9:113 (al-Jurjani, al-Sakkaki, al-Baqillani, al-Suyuti, tafsir balagha) for confirmation.
